scope: Generated MLINESTYLE OBJECTS writer allocation rollback, same-codec retry, and typed readback across supported DXF revisions.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored in-memory DRW_MLineStyle generated during each test run
source.profile: One two-element MLINESTYLE with BYLAYER and BYBLOCK built-in linetype references, nondefault offsets, ACI colors, scalar fields, and two EED values.

implementation.method: For each revision and encoding, calibrate allocations reached by writeMLineStyle() in the OBJECTS callback, inject bad_alloc at every measured offset, require destination and input record preservation, retry with the same codec, compare exact output bytes, and verify fresh typed MLINESTYLE readback.

validation.directControl: build/tests/libdxfrw_mline_style_objects_allocation_tests: PASS; seven revisions, both encodings, all 329 allocation offsets
validation.relatedSelector: ctest --test-dir build -R 'mline.*allocation' --output-on-failure: PASS 4/4 (includes three unrelated MLINE parser/DWG selectors)

limitations: Generated writer transaction and same-library typed readback only; producer interoperability, full reference closure, and native behavior are not qualified.
The profile uses built-in BYLAYER/BYBLOCK linetype meanings only and does not exercise named external linetype dependencies.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

planImpact.completedSlice: The generated two-element MLINESTYLE profile passes allocation rollback, input preservation, exact same-codec retry, and typed readback across AC1014/AC1015/AC1018/AC1021/AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 in ASCII and Binary.
